# Alpha (annualized, CAPM regression) (`alpha`)

*Category: Benchmark-relative analysis · Nature: model_dependent · Unit: decimal_return · Formula id: `alpha@v1` · Methodology 0.1.0*

## 1. What does it measure?

Average return not explained by benchmark exposure, annualized.

## 2. Formula

```text
P * a, with a the intercept of OLS: r_fund,t = a + b * r_bench,t + e_t
```

## 3. Required inputs

Fund and benchmark returns on aligned periods with a regular frequency. A benchmark is required.

## 4. Is higher or lower better?

Higher is better.

## 5. Plain-language interpretation

The part of the fund's yearly return that the benchmark does not explain; it depends heavily on which benchmark is used.

## 6. Professional interpretation

Jensen-style single-index alpha against the supplied benchmark with rf = 0, annualized arithmetically. Details report the per-period intercept, its standard error, t-statistic and p-value. Statistical significance, not the point estimate, indicates whether alpha is distinguishable from zero.

## 7. Assumptions

- Single-index (CAPM-style) model with the supplied benchmark.
- Risk-free rate 0%.
- Arithmetic annualization of the intercept.

## 8. When can it be misleading?

- The benchmark is not representative of the strategy's opportunity set.
- The overlap with the benchmark is short.
- Omitted risk factors (size, value, momentum, credit, illiquidity) masquerade as alpha.
- Returns are smoothed or the history is short.

## 9. Minimum sensible data

At least 3 aligned observations; low confidence below 3 years of overlap. (policy `benchmark_regression`: Requires at least 3 aligned observations; low confidence below 3 years of overlap, moderate below 5 years.)

## 10. Reference implementations

| Library | Function | Agrees | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| PerformanceAnalytics 2.0.4 (R) | `CAPM.alpha * P` | yes | PerformanceAnalytics reports the per-period intercept. |
| empyrical-reloaded 0.5.12 | `alpha` | no (documented difference) | empyrical annualizes geometrically: (1 + a)^P - 1. |

## 11. Sources

- Jensen, M. C. (1968). The Performance of Mutual Funds in the Period 1945-1964. Journal of Finance, 23(2), 389-416.
- Bacon, C. R. (2021). Practical Risk-Adjusted Performance Measurement (2nd ed.). Wiley.

## 12. OpenFactsheet convention

Per-period OLS intercept x periods per year (decision 0012).
